environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (not block), (2) Priority 200 - Custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per source IP with action BLOCK, (3) Priority 300 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics are enabled for all rules. The application container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite database is mounted from an EFS access point at /var/lib/app/.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, TLS 1.2 minimum
config.security_groups: sg-alb: inbound 443/tcp 0.0.0.0/0; sg-task: inbound 8080/tcp from sg-alb
